question: How is the supreme Lord identified through meaningful scriptural names?
premises: The Lord is taught through scriptural words whose meanings fit their referent.
This Lord is called the great Bhairava.
He is identified as the supreme Lord, Shiva.
inference: The meaningful scriptural names point to the same supreme reality: the great Bhairava, the Lord, Shiva.
plain_english: The Lord is taught through scriptural words whose meanings truly fit him: this great Bhairava is the supreme Lord, Shiva.
